title: Pet Cost Calculator
description: Estimate annual pet costs by pet type with fully editable line items.
howto: Choose your pet type to load typical cost items.
Edit any amount, add items, or remove ones that do not apply.
Read the annual total and the monthly average.
Switch pet type any time to compare (this resets the items).

faqs.q: What is included in the presets?
faqs.a: Typical annual items: food, vet care, grooming/litter/supplies, toys, and insurance where common. They are starting points, not quotes.

faqs.q: Does it include the adoption or purchase price?
faqs.a: No, only recurring annual costs. Add a one-time item yourself if you want it included.

faqs.q: Why did my items reset when I changed pet type?
faqs.a: Choosing a pet type loads its preset list, replacing your edits. Edit after choosing.
